desc: Enhance your accessory mounting platform on your rifle with this UTG Pro Ruger 10/22 Picatinny Rail Mount. These UTG Pro Riflescope Mounts & Bases are precision machined from anodized aircraft grade aluminum that is durable yet lightweight and resists corrosion over time to preserve their quality. With the UTG Pro MTU030T22 Picatinny Rail Mount, you get 11 Picatinny rail slots for all of your optic mounting needs. This mount is simple to install with the included assembly screws and requires absolutely no professional gunsmithing. Get your hands on the UTG Pro Ruger 10/22 Low Profile Picatinny Rail Mount to properly mount your sights and accessories.
